  - text: CLASS 10 · STATISTICS
  - heading "More-Than Ogive" [level=1]
  - paragraph: More-Than Ogive is a school mathematical idea in Statistics. It helps students model data, functions, curves, proofs, and 3D directions. We use related ideas in graphs, design, surveys, navigation, and measurement.
  - navigation: 18 min INTERMEDIATE CONCEPT statistics

    - img
    - text: Drag points on the curve or edit the table to see the ogive update in real time.
    - heading "How the median is read:" [level=3]
    - paragraph: For a more-than ogive, the median is read at the value of x where the ogive cuts the horizontal line at N/2.
    - paragraph: Here, the curve cuts N/2 = 15 at x ≈ 26.3. So, the median of the distribution is approximately 26.3.
